title: ATTRACT BLESSINGS THIS NEW WEEK
text: Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Give somebody a shout of praise right where you are. Come on, lift your voice and bless the name of the Lord. We are alive. We are well and we're in the presence of God this morning. That alone is enough reason to celebrate. I don't take it for granted that breath is in my nostrils. I don't take it for granted that my eyes open this morning. There are people who went to sleep last night and did not wake up this morning. But you woke up, you are reading this, you are watching this, you are here. And that means God still has a plan for you. That means your story is not over. That means the enemy did not have the final say. Come on, give God a shout of praise. Before we go any further, I want to encourage you. Share this prayer with someone. Share it with a friend. Share it with your family. Share it with someone who needs a word from heaven this morning. You never know who is sitting in discouragement, who is sitting in confusion, who went to bed last night wondering if God still remembers them. One click, one forward, one share, and the word of [music] the Lord will reach them. Please do that. Share this before we are done. Someone needs this today. Now let us pray together before we go any further. Father, we thank you. Lord God, we are grateful. We are not coming to you this morning because we are perfect. We are coming to you because you are good. We are not coming because we have it all together. We are coming because you are the God who puts things together. So Lord, as your word goes forth this morning, let it find the hearts that are ready. Let it water the seeds of faith in those who have been waiting. and let every person who encounters this word encounter you in the name of Jesus. Amen. Now I want to speak to you this morning about attracting blessings into your new week. I want you to understand something before we even begin. The word attract is very deliberate. It is not accidental. When something attracts, it means there is a magnetic pull. There is something on the inside that draws corresponding realities on the outside. And the kingdom of God operates on the principle of attraction. Let me show you this from scripture because I don't want you to follow my opinions. I want you to follow the word of God. Deuteronomy chapter 28 beginning from verse one, the spirit of God says, "And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the Lord thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth." And all these blessings shall come on thee and overtake thee if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God. Did you see that? The blessings shall come on you. The blessing shall overtake you. God did not say you would chase the blessings. He said the blessings would chase you. He said the blessings would come running after you. That tells me there is a positioning. There is a condition that makes a man magnetic to the blessings of God. This is not prosperity preaching. This is covenant theology. This is the consistent testimony of scripture from Genesis to Revelation. Everywhere you look, you see God blessing people. Not by accident, not randomly, not arbitrarily, but in response to something, in response to alignment, in response to obedience, in response to faith, in response to encounter. [music] And this morning by the spirit of the living God, I want to position you to attract the blessings of God into this new week and beyond. Somebody say with me, I am a blessing magnet. Say it again like you believe it. I am a blessing magnet. [music] I need you to understand that poverty is not humility. Lack is not spirituality. God dressing his children in rags is not a sign that he is holy. It is a sign that something is out of alignment. Because look at Abraham. God called Abraham and almost immediately he said, "I will bless thee and make thy name great." Look at Isaac in the time of famine. In the same land where everyone was suffering, Isaac sowed and reaped a hundfold. In the same year, in the same economic climate, look at Joseph. Even in prison, favor found him. Even in captivity, blessing [music] tracked him down. Why? Because the hand of God was on him. because God was with him. Because something on the inside of Joseph made him magnetic to the goodness of God. I want that for you this week. I want you to go into this week not begging, not hoping, not just wishing, but walking in the consciousness that you are anointed for increase. You are positioned [music] for promotion. You are marked by heaven for uncommon results. Now, I want to give you the keys. I want to show you the spiritual laws that govern the attraction of blessing [music] because the kingdom operates on laws. The kingdom is not chaotic. God is not unpredictable. He is consistent. He is faithful. And when you understand the laws, you can cooperate with them. The first thing I want to show you is this blessing is attracted by the presence of God in your life. This is the master key. Everything else I say this morning will flow from this. Genesis 26:12, "Then Isaac sold in that land and received in the same year a hundfold, and the Lord blessed him." And in verse 28, the Philistines came to Isaac and said, "We saw certainly that the Lord was with thee." Do you understand what that means? The evidence of the blessing in Isaac's life was so undeniable that even his enemies came to testify. They didn't come because Isaac was educated, though education is good. They didn't come because Isaac had great business strategies. Though wisdom is important. They came because the Lord was with him. The presence of God in a man's life is [music] the greatest competitive advantage in the universe. This is why the first thing we must do before anything else is pursue the presence of God. Not just church attendance, not just religious routine, not just saying prayers out of habit, but genuinely, passionately, consistently cultivating the presence of God. David understood this. David said in Psalm 16:1, "Thou will show me the path of life. In thy presence is fullness of joy." [music] At thy right hand there are pleasures forever more. At his right hand there are pleasures. not pain, not poverty, not confusion, pleasures. When you are in his presence, there is fullness, fullness of joy, fullness of direction, fullness of provision, fullness of healing, fullness of wisdom. So this morning, I want to ask you, how is your relationship with God? Not your theology, not your church membership, not how well you know doctrine, how is your relationship with him? Because doctrine without relationship produces religion. And religion will not attract blessings. It will only attract performance. God is not impressed by your performance. He's moved [music] by your heart. He is drawn to your hunger. He responds to your desperation. Come on, somebody begin to stare your spirit right now. Say, "Lord, I want your presence more than I want anything else." Say that from your heart this morning. If you are willing to prioritize his presence, you are setting yourself up for a week of supernatural attraction. Things will begin to locate you. Opportunities will find you. Helpers of destiny will appear from nowhere. Because when God is with you, everything that is supposed to be with you will find you. Now, the second key I want to give you is this. Blessing is attracted by the word of God dwelling richly in you. Colossians 3:16 says, "Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly, not occasionally, not conveniently, richly, abundantly." The word of God is seed. Jesus said in Luke 8 that the sewer went out to sew and the seed is the word of God. Now here is the law. Wherever there is seed in good soil, there will be a harvest. There is no seed without harvest. There is no word without result. Isaiah 55-11, [music] God declares it himself. So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth. It shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please. and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it. The word of God is a sent thing. When it enters your spirit and takes root, it is sent to accomplish something. It is sent to prosper something. It is on an assignment inside you. This is why the enemy fights your devotion to the word. This is why the enemy creates busyness, creates distraction, creates a culture where people scroll on their phones for 3 hours but cannot sit with the Bible for 30 minutes because he knows if the word gets into [music] your spirit, the harvest is inevitable. So, one of the practical things I want to challenge you to do this week is to be intentional with the word of God. Don't just read it, meditate on it. Meditate on it. Joshua 1:8 says, "This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth, but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein. For then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success." The promise of prosperity and success in this verse is directly tied to the meditation of the word. This is not a mystery. This is a law. Cooperate with the law. I want you to pick a verse [music] this week. just one verse, a promise from God, a scripture that speaks to what you are believing God for. And I want you to chew on it. I want you to speak it out loud. I want you to pray it back to God. Let it sit in your spirit until it produces a holy boldness, until it produces a confidence in God that the enemy cannot shake. That is how the word works. The word works by dwelling. The word works by abiding. Now the third key and this one is going to disturb some of you in the best possible way. Blessing is attracted by generosity. I need you to stay with me here. [music] Luke 6:38. Jesus said it. Jesus, not Paul, not James. Jesus, give and it shall be given unto you good measure pressed down and shaken together and running over shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye met me without, it shall be measured to you again. Now I want you to notice the architecture of that verse. The giving precedes the receiving. The release precedes the return. And the return is not equal to the giving. It is pressed down, shaken together, running over. The return is disproportionate to the giving. God is not an equal exchange partner. God is an overwhelming multiplier. Proverbs 11:24-5 says, "And this will challenge your logic." There is that scatterth and yet increasth, and there is that withholdeth more than [music] his meat. But it tendeth to poverty. The liberal soul shall be made fat, and he that waterth shall be watered also himself. This is counterintuitive. The one who scatters, the one who releases, the one who gives generously increases. But the one who withholds beyond what is right tends to poverty. Not because God is punishing them but because they have cut off the flow. Generosity opens a pipeline of heavenly supply. When you give, you are not losing, you are planting. And everything you plant in faith will grow. I want to challenge you this week. Look for an opportunity to give. Give to your church. Give to a ministry that is blessing your life. Give to a person in need. Give beyond your comfort zone. Not because God needs your money. He owns the cattle on a thousand hills. But because generosity is a spiritual posture that opens the heavens and when the heavens are open over you, everything changes. There is also a dimension of generosity that goes beyond money. Be generous with your time. Be generous with your encouragement. Be generous with your prayers for others. Intercede for someone this week who cannot pray for themselves. Be the person in the room who lifts others. Be the voice that speaks life into someone's situation because you will harvest in the same dimension you sow. If you sow encouragement, encouragement will [music] find you. If you sow prayers, prayer will surround you. If you sow joy into people's lives, joy will overflow in yours. Now, I want to talk about the fourth key and I want to be very precise here. Blessing is attracted by faithfilled declarations. Proverbs 18:21, the Bible says, "The tongue has the power of [music] life and death, not suggestion, not influence. Power." The tongue carries creative power because we are made in the image of God. And God created everything with words. He said, "Let there be light." And light appeared. He said, "Let the earth bring forth." And it brought forth. He spoke to the waters and they separated. The same creative ability, though in a derivative, limited sense, lives in the tongue of the believer. And every morning when you wake up, you are setting the atmosphere for your day with what comes out of your mouth. Romans 4:17 says that God callth those things which be [music] not as though they were. He speaks about realities that don't yet exist in the natural as though they already exist. And he commands us to walk in the same pattern of faith. So this week, I don't want you to wake up and start complaining about the economy. I don't want you to wake up and say, "Nothing good ever happens to me. I don't want you to wake up and rehearse your disappointments from last week and drag them into this new week." No, this is a new week. This is a blank page. And God is handing you the pen. Open your mouth and declare this week I am walking in supernatural favor. Open your mouth and declare goodness and mercy are following me. Open your mouth and say I am the head and not the tail. I am above and not beneath. I am blessed going in and blessed going out. These are not [music] empty words. These are covenant realities from Deuteronomy 28 that belong to the child of God. When you declare them, you are agreeing with heaven. You are saying what God has already said. You are aligning your words with the word and the atmosphere must shift. Job 22:28, thou shalt also decree a thing and it shall be established unto thee. There is a decree before there is an establishment. The establishment in the natural follows the decree in the spirit. So decree your week before it happens. Decree your finances before the bills arrive. Decree your health before the symptoms speak. Decree your peace before the chaos tries to enter because you have been given authority in the name of Jesus Christ and that authority is exercised through declaration. Come on, somebody begin to open your mouth right now and say, "This week I attract blessings. This week I attract divine connections. This week I attract supernatural opportunities. This week I attract the goodness of God." Say it. Say it with conviction. Say it with the boldness of a son or daughter of the most high God because you are not nobody. You are not a spiritual orphan. You are seated in heavenly places in Christ Jesus. And from that position of authority, [music] you decree this week belongs to me. Now the fifth key and this is perhaps the most neglected among believers. Blessing is attracted by peace. I know that sounds quiet. I know it sounds almost too simple, but let me show you from scripture. Isaiah 32-17 says, "And the work of righteousness shall be peace, and the effect of righteousness, quietness and assurance forever." The effect of righteousness of right relationship with God is quietness. It is assurance, not anxiety, not panic, not striving. Isaiah 48:18 God says to Israel, "Oh, that thou hast hearkened to my commandments." Then had thy peace [music] been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea, peace like a river, constant flowing uninterrupted. And Psalm 29-11 declares, "The Lord will give strength unto [music] his people. The Lord will bless his people with peace." God blesses with peace. Peace is not the absence of blessing. Peace is a form of blessing and peace is also a conductor of blessing. When you are at peace, you can hear clearly. When you are at peace, you can [music] think wisely. When you at peace, you make better decisions. When you are at peace, you are not moved by every word of bad news on the news. You are not shaken by every negative report. You are anchored in the confidence that God is working all things together for your good. Philippians 4:7 says that the peace of God passes all understanding. It surpasses comprehension. It is a supernatural calm that exists even when the circumstances give you every natural reason to panic. And when you operate from that place of peace, you become magnetic to heaven's solutions, heaven's strategies, heaven's resources, because God can deposit into a quiet spirit. It is hard for God to get a word into a life that is in constant turmoil. So cultivate peace. Guard your peace. Protect your atmosphere. Not every conversation deserves your participation. Not every argument deserves your energy. Not every negative voice deserves your audience. Be intentional about the environment of peace in your soul. The sixth key blessing is attracted by gratitude. Thanksgiving is not just an emotional expression. It is a spiritual currency. Psalm 100 vers4, enter into his gates with thanksgiving and into his courts with praise. Be thankful unto him and bless his name. Thanksgiving is how you enter the gates of God. It is the doorway to his presence. And I've already told you that his presence is the master key to attraction. So thanksgiving is a key to the key. It takes you into the place where everything is. When Paul was writing to the church in Philippi, he said in Philippians 4:6, "Be careful for nothing, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving, let your [music] requests be made known unto God." Did you catch that? With thanksgiving, not just requests, not just petitions, but thanksgiving accompanying the requests. Why? Because thanksgiving is the language of faith. When you thank God before you see the result, you are saying I believe you have already done it. You are saying I trust you even before I have the evidence. And faith, genuine, active express faith moves the hand of God. Let me give you a practical challenge. Every morning this week, before you make any request to God, spend at least 5 minutes just thanking him, not for what he is about to do. Thank him for what he has already done. Thank him that you are saved. Thank him for the blood of Jesus. Thank him for the Holy Spirit. Thank him for your family, for your health, for every breath you have taken. Build a culture of gratitude and watch how quickly the atmosphere of your life shifts. Watch how the heaviness lifts. Watch how joy returns. Watch how clarity comes. Because an ungrateful heart repels blessing, [music] but a grateful heart attracts the overflow of heaven. Now, I want to pray with you. But before I pray, let me say one more thing. The seventh key and this is the one that will unlock everything blessing is attracted by righteousness. Not just moral behavior though that matters but righteousness in its full biblical sense. Right standing with God, alignment with the covenant, agreement with the purposes of God. Matthew 6:33, Jesus said it clearly. But seek ye first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things shall be added unto you. Not sought, not walked for, added. When you seek God first, when you put his kingdom as the non-negotiable priority, the things you need begin to be added to your life. [music] It is not something you chase. It is something that catches you because of where you [music] are standing. Proverbs 10:22 says, "The blessing of the Lord, it maketh [music] rich and he addeth no sorrow with it." The blessing of the Lord, not the blessing of your strategy alone, not the blessing of your connections alone, the blessing of the Lord, that is what we are after. Not the counterfeits, not the blessing that comes with sorrow attached to it. Not success [music] that destroys your health. Not financial increase that cost you your family. The blessing of the Lord which brings increase in every dimension of life. Spiritual increase, physical health, mental clarity, financial provision, relational flourishing. The blessing of the Lord is a whole life blessing and it is yours this week. It is yours by [music] covenant. It is yours because of the blood of Jesus. Galatians 3:13:14 says, "Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us, that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ." The blessing of Abraham, let me tell you what that includes. Abraham was blessed in all things. Genesis 24:1, he was blessed materially. He was blessed in his relationships. He was blessed in his purpose. He was blessed with the presence of God. All of that was secured for you the moment Jesus went to that cross and redeemed you from every cause. Every form of lack, every form of stagnation, every form of limitation that came through Adam, Jesus reversed it and you are walking in the reversal this week. Come on, somebody shout hallelujah. Now let us go into prayer. I want you to get serious with me right now. If you are in a place where you can lift your hands, lift them. If you are driving, keep your eyes on the road and agree in your heart. If you can stand to your feet, stand. We are going to enter the presence of God right now with boldness because Hebrews 4:16 says we can come boldly to the throne of grace. We are not strangers. We are sons and daughters. We are not beggars. We are hes. So let us pray with that consciousness. Father, in the name of Jesus, we enter your presence with thanksgiving. We thank you for the blood of Jesus that gives us access. access to you, access to your grace, access to your favor, access to your power. We thank you that because of the cross, there is no barrier between us and you. The veil was torn from top to bottom. You tore it, Lord, not from the bottom up as man would tear it, but from the top down because this was your initiative. You wanted access to us even more than we wanted access [music] to you. Lord, we are grateful. We bless your name now. Father, in the name of Jesus, I speak over every person who is encountering this word this morning. I speak over every life known and unknown, near and far, every soul that this prayer reaches. Lord, let your blessing descend upon them as the dw of Hammon descends upon the mountains of Zion. Let it come silently, supernaturally, irreversibly. Lord, I decree in the name of Jesus, this is a new week of divine attraction. Every person praying with me right now, I declare that blessing shall chase them this week. Supernatural favor shall locate them. Doors that were shut shall swing open. Opportunities that were hidden shall be revealed. Connections that were delayed shall be accelerated. In the name of Jesus, I speak to every spirit of stagnation. Your assignment is terminated. The blood of Jesus speaks against you. Every pattern of limitation that has followed this person from last year into this year, I uproot it in the name of Jesus. Every cycle of almost there, every cycle of almost breakthrough but not quite, I break that cycle in the name of Jesus. By the power of the Holy Spirit, I declare a new cycle begins this week. A cycle of arrival, a cycle of completion, a cycle of testimony in Jesus mighty name. Father, I pray for supernatural provision over every person praying this prayer. Lord, you know their needs. You know their financial situations. You know the bills. You know the debts. You know the dreams that are waiting on resources. Lord, release resources. Cause money to come from expected and unexpected sources. Let the wealth of the sinner be transferred according to your word. Let the favor of the Lord make room for abundance. Let this be the week of financial breakthrough of supernatural supply of the God of more than enough showing up in practical tangible ways in the name of Jesus. For every business person praying this prayer, Lord, bring wisdom, bring divine strategies, bring the right clients, the right partnerships, the right ideas. Let this be a week of expansion, not contraction, a week of increase, not decrease. For every employee, Lord, let them be distinguished in their workplace. Let them have the spirit of Daniel 10 times better than their colleagues, not because of arrogance, but because your hand is upon them. Let promotions be released. Let recognition be given. Let salary increases happen suddenly and supernaturally in the name of Jesus. For every student praying this prayer, Lord, open their understanding. Give them the spirit of wisdom and revelation. Let their memory be sharp. Let their comprehension be extraordinary. Let them not just pass. Let them excel. Let them top their classes. Let them be given divine insight in their examinations. Let their results speak of the God who made them in the name of Jesus. For every person who is sick, every person praying this [music] prayer with a physical challenge, with a medical report that is troubling them. Lord Jesus, you are Jehovah Rafa. You are the Lord that healeth. Let healing flow from the top of their head to the soles of their feet. Let every organ function as you designed [music] it. Let every system in their body come into alignment with heaven's blueprint. Lord, let this week be the week their healing is [music] manifest. Not next month, not next year, this week. In the name of Jesus, by the stripes of Jesus, they [music] are healed. For every person who is waiting for a child, every person who has received a report of barness, every couple that has been trusting God for the fruit of the womb, Lord God, you are the one who opened Sarah's womb. You are the one who heard Hannah's cry. You are the one who visited Rachel. You are the same God this morning. Visit every [music] waiting womb. Silence every medical report that contradicts your word. Let conception happen. Let babies be carried to full term. Let testimonies of new life emerge from this prayer in the name of Jesus. For every person battling anxiety and depression, Lord God, let your peace invade their mind right now. Not gradually, right now, let the peace that passes understanding garrison their mind. Let every anxious thought be arrested by the name of Jesus. Let every spirit of heaviness be displaced by the garment of praise. Father, I pray for supernatural joy this week. Not happiness that depends on circumstances, but the joy of the Lord that is their strength. The joy that the enemy cannot explain. The joy that survives bad news. The joy that endures difficult seasons. Let that joy arise in their spirit like a river this week. [music] In the mighty name of Jesus, I release the blood of Jesus over every home represented in this prayer. Let the blood of Jesus speak over every marriage, every home that the enemy has targeted for destruction. I rebuke that assignment in the name of Jesus. Let peace return to troubled homes. Let love be rekindled in cold relationships. Let communication be restored where there has been silence. Let forgiveness flow where there has been bitterness. Let the spirit of the Lord bring unity to divided families in the name of Jesus. every child that has gone prodigal, every son and daughter that has walked away from God, from family, from purpose. Lord, release the spirit of conviction upon them. Let the Holy Spirit pursue them this week. Let there be a divine interruption in their path, a moment that stops them, that turns them, that brings them home. Let this be the week that the fathers and mothers who have been praying receive news of restoration. The prodigal shall return in the name of Jesus. Now I want to address the enemies, the spiritual forces that have been working against destinies. Every principality and power that has been assigned against the people praying this prayer, I serve you. Notice in the name of Jesus Christ, your assignment is revoked. Your legal right has been destroyed by the blood of Jesus. The word says in Colossians 2:15 that Jesus spoiled principalities and powers and made an open show of them, triumphing over them. That triumph is still in effect. That victory is still current and we're enforcing it this morning. Every satanic embgo and blessing removed in the name of Jesus. Every witchcraft interference with destiny dismantled in the name of Jesus. Every evil altar speaking against these lives, silenced in the name of Jesus. I release angelic activity on behalf of every person praying this prayer. The Bible says in Hebrews 1:14 that angels are ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation. You are an heir. The angels are on assignment for you. Lord, let your angels go ahead of these people [music] into this new week. Let your angels prepare the path. Let them move obstacles. Let them prepare tables in the midst of enemies. Let them guard the going out and the coming in. Let them war in the heavenlies on behalf of these destinies [music] in the name of Jesus. Now let me speak a word of prophecy in the spirit. There is someone praying this prayer who has been on the verge of giving up. You have been on the edge of quitting quitting your faith, [music] quitting your dream, quitting your pursuit of God. You have said in your heart, what is the point? I have been trusting God for so long and I don't see results. I want you to know God sees you. God hears you. And he says to you this morning what he said to the disciples when they had fished all night and caught nothing. Cast the net on the right side. Don't stop now. Don't quit now. You are one act of obedience away from your harvest. You are one more step away from your breakthrough. Don't cast away your confidence which has great recompense of reward. Hold on. The harvest is here in the name of Jesus. There is someone else who has been carrying a burden that was never designed for you to carry alone. God says this morning, "Cast [music] it on me." 1 Peter 5:7, "Casting all your care upon him, for he cared for you. You are loved. You are seen." You are not alone in this. Heaven is with you. Let go of the weight. Let go of the striving. Let God be God in your situation. [music] He is more than capable and he is more than willing. Receive his rest this morning. There is also a word for someone whose finances have been in a long season of drought. The spirit of the Lord says this week the rain begins. This week the dry season [music] ends. You will see provision come from directions you did not plan for. You will see generosity shown to you by people who were not in your expectation. God is moving. The brook is about to overflow. Receive it by faith. Say I receive it out loud. I also want to prophesy over someone who has been praying about a specific relationship, a marriage, a partnership, a divine connection. God says the connection is near. What you have been asking for is closer than it appears. Don't compromise the standard in the process of waiting. Don't settle. God is faithful and what he has promised he is able to perform. This week there will be a development. There will be a sign. Pay attention. The answer to your prayer is on the way. Father, we seal this prayer in the blood of Jesus. Everything that has been spoken over every life, let it be established. Let it be permanent. Let no power of darkness overturn it. The Bible says in Numbers 23:23, "There is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against [music] Israel." What God has blessed, let no man cause what God has decreed, let no devil reverse. We seal it with the blood. We seal it with the name that is above every name, the name of Jesus. And we seal it by the authority of the Holy Spirit who is present in this place in this moment with every person praying now. Lord, we give you glory. We give you glory in advance. We will not wait until we see the evidence before we praise you. We praise you now. We praise you before the manifestation. We praise you because you are faithful and your word does not fail. And we declare this is the best week of our lives. Not because everything is perfect, but because you are perfect and you are with us. And that is more than enough. In the name of Jesus Christ, the name above every name, the name at which every knee shall bow and every tongue shall confess. We pray. We have prayed and it is done. Amen. And amen. Now before you go, I said it at the beginning and I want to say it at the end. Please share this prayer. Someone in your contact list needs this word today. Someone in your family is struggling in silence. Someone in your WhatsApp group or your social media feed is carrying a burden that this word is designed to break. You don't need to add any commentary. Just forward it. Just send it. One act of generosity with this word could change someone's entire week, someone's entire year, someone's entire life. Go into this week knowing that you are blessed. Go in knowing that you are favored. Go in knowing that the Lord is your shepherd and you shall not want. Go in knowing that the same God who parted the Red Sea is walking with you through whatever challenge you are facing. He is the same yesterday, today, and forever. His faithfulness is not seasonal. His love is not conditional. And his blessing upon your life is not theoretical. It is covenantal. [music] This week, walk in it. Wear it. Release it. And when the testimonies come and they will come, give God the glory. Come back and testify. Let your testimony become someone else's faith. Let what God does for you this week be a prophetic word to someone else that their own breakthrough is possible. Go in peace. Go in power. Go in the name of Jesus and attract every blessing that heaven has prepared for you this week. Shalom.
